summary: Server-owned developer permission per registered account; hidden Admin / Debug option in Windows/Android client, protected read-only diagnostics, operator CLI, additive schema v3 migration and regression tests.

implemented.title: Server-gated Admin / Debug developer diagnostics
implemented.summary: Add SocialAccount.developerEnabled (default false) and a local LoopRD host operator command to set/revoke it; server checks flag per diagnostics request. Client hides the switch and page for normal users and clears it on server revocation.
operator_checks: Back up LoopRD Social SQLite database and activate the v3 additive migration; verify previously registered accounts retain sign-in and developerEnabled defaults to false.
Run tools/social-developer-access.py on the LoopRD host with --db, --user and --enable; sign in and check Settings gains Show developer tools, initially off.
Enable the UI switch; verify the read-only Admin / Debug tab shows sanitized platform release, schema, session counts and client connection diagnostics.
Disable the flag on the server; verify the client removes the diagnostics on the next sync or request and that direct developer_diagnostics calls fail even for previously enabled sessions.
Verify another account and a legacy development token cannot access developer_diagnostics or grant themselves developerEnabled.

remaining.title: Account recovery and hardened public registration
remaining.summary: Social-owned password recovery and device management, optional email verification/invite controls, abuse prevention, security review and production readiness remain to be implemented. External OIDC not required.

remaining.title: Private groups and game invitations
remaining.summary: Buddy list/direct messages are implemented in this pass. Group conversation membership, game invitations, moderation and game ticket authorization still need Social and game-side contracts.

remaining.title: Android background push and turn delivery
remaining.summary: Turn notifications work while the client is running; provide Social-owned device push registration and a push provider to wake Android after app termination.

remaining.title: Native build and device acceptance
remaining.summary: Current v0.3.1 native Windows/Android installers and GUI acceptance remain to be verified on GitHub/physical devices; source tests only are locally available.

remaining.title: Game activity integration
remaining.summary: Each game hosted on the selected LoopRD server must implement its own turn-activity contract for automatic alerts; the Social app cannot fabricate turns.

remaining.title: Secure persistent device login
remaining.summary: Currently device session token is memory-only; add native OS-secure storage with explicit remembered-device management and logout/remote revoke controls.
